text: The cinema says no outside food.
The Supreme Court says they can: cinemas set their own entry rules.
But cinemas told the court drinking water is free.
They also said a child's food is allowed, in reasonable amounts.
On a medical diet? The court asked cinemas to consider it, case by case.
Ask for free water, pack your child's food, and show the manager a doctor's note.
